description: Performance Metrics - Transportation - Traffic Lights Out is a dataset listed in City of Chicago open data portal (data.cityofchicago.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Chicago. The Chicago Department of Transportation (CDOT) receives reports from 311’s Customer Service Requests (CSR) system of traffic light outages. This metric tracks the average number of days CDOT takes to complete traffic light repair requests. Coverage: Chicago. The portal files it under the category Administration & Finance. Its tags are service delivery, performance metrics, traffic light, outage. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Chicago. The portal shows 2014-05-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofchicago-org-portal.
